Run the released pack and NERV's cases against gemma4:12b on Ollama; record the result in docs/agents/model-profiles.json; an unqualified model keeps the refusal reply

validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: pin the release and run two packs; the wait on gauntlet-protocol is not counted. Not a measurement.
